cases_hash_basis: UTF-8 text with LF line endings
selection_basis: 108 independent development families only (variants excluded); >=95% accepted precision and <=5% no-match false acceptance when feasible; maximize correct accepted, prefer conservative surface on ties. Fresh test uninspected before freezing.
rerank_selection_basis: Dense 0.76/0.04 frozen. Floor, reranker score and margin chosen on 108 development families only; adopt only if correct accepted rises with >=95% precision and <=5% false acceptance. Test split reused, not fresh.
